about_the_game:
Two the Top is a cooperative precision platformer where the only obstacle is falling. Bring a friend along and work together as you brave the heights on your journey to the top!

  • Simple-to-learn controls. (Left, Right, Jump, Yoyo)

  • Journey through many different environments with their own unique challenges!

  • Watch your step, there are No Checkpoints in this game.

  • Take a break at any time, the game will remember exactly where you last left off and will put you back on track when you return!

Invite a friend along to join for free using the friend pass! Only ONE player needs to own the game to unlock the full experience!

(If both players are using the friend pass, you'll only have access to the demo portion of the game.)

A journey for two;

Bounce off your partner's head to boost high up into the air, and let down your yoyo to let them climb up after you!

Nail-Biting, High-Stakes Level Design where every jump is meaningful and holds weight; each fall is an opportunity to learn and improve.

There are no checkpoints in this game, so patience, communication and coordination will be put to the test, so be kind to your partner, as the climb can be stressful at times!

Each zone contains a much harder alternate path with a treat at the end for climbers daring enough to try for it.

This is a tough experience that's not for everyone; this game can be brutally punishing but greatly rewarding as well. If that isn't for you, you might want to pass on this one.

However, if you persist, you might find something you love.

So...

Can you both make it to the top?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100T or AMD FX6100
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 7600 GS (512 MB) or equivalent
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 300 MB available space

short_description: A simple-to-learn, hard-to-master co-op platformer where the only obstacle is falling. Bring a friend along for free with the Friend's Pass and work together as you face this fair but tough adventure that teaches with every mistake.
